$comment: Every country the app knows. The Phase 1 exit criterion — adding a country means editing THIS FILE (plus its facts) and nothing else, no engine change, no screen change — has now been exercised fifty-five times rather than argued about. packages/engines/src/content/thesis.test.ts still asserts it. Author by SUBREGION: a subregion with fewer than four members cannot fill a four-option question, so a country added alone teaches nobody until its neighbours land. `pnpm content:stats` says which are thin.
